newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Denmark grants $48 mln for Vietnam water supply.
newsitem.headline: Denmark grants $48 mln for Vietnam water supply.

text.p: Denmark has agreed to grant Vietnam $48 million for four water supply and sanitation projects which will be implemented over the next five years, the Danish embassy in Hanoi said on Wednesday.

The grant will be spent on a water supply project in the northern coast city of Halong, on assistance to a water supply and sanitation project in Buon Ma Thuot, Dak Lak province, and rehabilitation of the water distribution system in the central highlands town of Dalat.
The funds will also provide assistance to the government in formulating a national rural water supply and sanitation strategy.

"Approximately 500,000 people will receive clean water in the cities mentioned and the strategy study will form the basis for providing water to the rural areas...in an environmentally and financially sustainable manner," the embassy said in a statement.
